summary: Vale S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its Annual and Extraordinary General Meetings held on April 30, 2026. The meetings included routine items such as approving financial statements, setting management compensation, electing a Fiscal Council, ratifying a board appointment, and approving the mergers of wholly-owned subsidiaries Baovale Mineração S.A. and CDA Logística S.A. into Vale without a capital increase or new share issuance. No premium, price per share, or deal terms were disclosed. This filing represents standard corporate governance and internal restructuring, not a special situation.
